title: Senate ethics hearing vs Bato may proceed
summary: The Senate committee on ethics can proceed with a hearing on the complaint against Sen. Ronald dela Rosa over his prolonged absence even without his response, panel chairperson Senate President Pro…

blocks.text: Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa attends the Senate session on Monday, May 11, 2026, hours before being placed under Senate protective custody amid reports of an alleged ICC arrest warrant.

MANILA, Philippines — The Senate committee on ethics can proceed with a hearing on the complaint against Sen. Ronald dela Rosa over his prolonged absence even without his response, panel chairperson Senate President Pro Tempore Vicente Sotto III said yesterday.
“Yes (we can proceed), and also simultaneously, I will ask the rules (committee) to already consider the proposal of the ethics (committee) re absent senators,” he said.
Sotto’s remarks come after the ethics panel reiterated its order for Dela Rosa to answer the complaint, clarifying that no additional affidavits are forthcoming from the complainants.

In a letter dated Nov. 20, Sotto informed Dela Rosa that “no other submission has been made in relation to the complaint apart from those transmitted to you under the Committee’s letter dated Oct. 22, 2026.”
